description: This file is a Python module that provides JSON serialization and deserialization functions for Flask applications, including dumps, dump, loads, load, and jsonify, with support for current_app context.

methods.name: dumps
methods.description: Serialize data as JSON, using current_app.json.dumps if available, otherwise json.dumps.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Serialize data as JSON and write to a file, using current_app.json.dump if available.

methods.name: loads
methods.description: Deserialize JSON data from a string or bytes, using current_app.json.loads if available.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Deserialize JSON data from a file, using current_app.json.load if available.

methods.name: jsonify
methods.description: Serialize arguments as JSON and return a Flask Response object with application/json MIME type, using current_app.json.response.
